Context: 7. Attachment for debt and maintenance

- (6) If a new attachment order has the result of increasing the amount beyond the maximum limits prescribed, the Disbursing Officer shall return the attachment order to the Court concerned with a statement showing-
3. (i)
4. Particulars of the existing attachment;
5. Particulars of the amount withheld and paid into the Court
6. (ii) concerned up to date; and
7. (iii)
8. Amount remaining uncovered.  
[ Rule 176 (1), Postal FHB, Vol. I, Rule 2.4 (7) (g), R & P Rules and Rule 226-A, CTR.]
